thread:
miranda: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem  propose two things: 1) a dedicated PM action board (owners, due dates, verifiers) 2) short IC rotation + comms cadence doc. Thoughts?

alex_m: +1. Board visibility helps. Proposed columns: Backlog / Assigned / In progress / Blocked / Complete / Verified.

alex_m: Timeline template (to include in board):
```text
- Incident timeline (detection -> mitigation -> root cause)
- Immediate mitigations (who, when)
- Postmortem owner
- Action items:
  - Action: short description
  - Owner: @handle
  - Due: YYYY-MM-DD
  - Priority: P1/P2/P3
  - Status: Backlog/In progress/Blocked/Complete/Verified
- Recurrence check window: (30/60/90 days)
- Postmortem publish date
```

sam_dev: Comms cadence proposal: initial public comms within 10m by IC, updates every 30m until stable, final summary in #incidents when resolved. Draft PM due within 72h, final PM in 7 days.

paul_s: IC rotation: 1-week IC shift aligned with oncall, named backup, roster in Confluence + calendar reminders. Avoid assigning new hires their first week. Also capture recurring patterns monthly (e.g., top 5 incident tags).

incident-bot: Created ticket RED-INC-ACT-2026 and assigned to miranda :ticket:

natacha: Add recurrence tags on PMs (network/scaling/regression/config). Surface trend dashboard in Console for SRE/product. Monthly trend review meeting OK.

miranda: Can someone spin the template into Jira + create the board? @alex_m volunteer? Suggest SLAs for action closure: P1=14d, P2=30d, P3=90d.

alex_m: I'll create the Jira board and import template today; will post link here when done. Proposing a weekly 30-min "PM review" (Thu 10:00) to go over open actions. :thumbsup: 

sam_dev: If Jira, add watchers for product/security and a custom field "Incident recurrence risk" (low/med/high). Also add a Verifier field.

paul_s: Each action should include a "Verifier" and a one-line test proving the fix post-deploy.

miranda: Initial rollout owners: alex_m (board + template), natacha (trend dashboard sketch), paul_s (verification checklist & one-line tests), sam_dev (Jira fields & watchers). Target: draft board + template + dashboard sketch by EOD +3 days. Weekly PM review starts next Thu.

alex_m: Got it  will post board link and sample tickets by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark: 

sam_dev: Will help define recurrence risk taxonomy.

paul_s: I'll add verifier checklist to runbook and link from board.

incident-bot: Reminder created: weekly PM review (eng-oncall) Thursdays 10:00 starting 2026-04-02

miranda: Thanks all. Main goal: fewer lost action items and clearer ownership. We'll iterate after first week. :eyes:
